_about: LGIC_LGCTFM round 10 fixed input. THE ONE CARRIER of the record shape (S85). ONE cell, cut on 1.0.0_SA_CTO's L10 round-9 analysis @25bd9cb1fd s.2 and s.6, and 3.0.0_SA_CVO's L9 @dbd706fcea. Round 9 STANDS; M1R9-AC4 PASS across all five classes; no PRD addendum owed.

WHY_THE_CLASS_SPLITS.claim: held -- 3.0.0_SA_CVO's L9 finding, adopted by 1.0.0_SA_CTO and turned into a taxonomy act
WHY_THE_CLASS_SPLITS.the_finding_verbatim: THE RECORD FLATTENS A DISTINCTION THAT MATTERS: a future round reading 'UNEXECUTABLE-AS-ROUTED x2' will treat both as equally blocked when ONE HAS A CHEAP ADDITIVE RE-ROUTE AND THE OTHER HAS NONE.
WHY_THE_CLASS_SPLITS.S18: asks for an ARM in check_lt_r1.py. An arm must be dispatched by the checker's own CMD table, so NO SIBLING CAN ADD ONE. Unexecutable IN PRINCIPLE from any cell barred from editing a closed round's pinned input.
WHY_THE_CLASS_SPLITS.W1_S21: asks for DOCUMENTATION, and its own basis says the causes must be carried WHERE A LATER RE-DERIVATION WILL MEET THEM -- a PLACEMENT requirement, not an edit. A conformant additive alternative EXISTS: a sibling document in fixed_inputs/r1/, exactly the shape LGIC_ENFORCE round 16 ruled for RETIRED.md.
WHY_THE_CLASS_SPLITS.the_class_name_was_still_right: 'AS ROUTED' is the operative qualifier and as routed into 'that arm's own carrier' W1-S21 does require the barred edit. The round-9 cell was correct; the RECORD was lossy.

the_split.UNEXECUTABLE-AS-ROUTED-RE-ROUTABLE: the routed form is barred AND a conformant alternative EXISTS. The row NAMES the alternative.
the_split.UNEXECUTABLE-IN-PRINCIPLE: no conformant form exists from any cell so barred. The row NAMES what would have to change for one to exist.

WHY_THE_CLASS_SPLITS.and_neither_is_assertable_by_shrugging: BOTH classes must NAME something. A row that says only 'blocked' satisfies neither. COST: one field per row in that class. NON-APPLICATION: a row executable as routed.

THE_RE_ROUTE_ITSELF.what: W1-S21's conformant re-route: a SIBLING DOCUMENT in fixed_inputs/r1/ carrying the three drift causes, on the RETIRED.md precedent. Cheap, additive, and it closes a row that has been reading as blocked.
THE_RE_ROUTE_ITSELF.why_a_sibling_is_conformant: a new file beside the checker changes NO blob any proof pinned, and it is discoverable by anyone who opens the directory in order to run the checker -- which is precisely where W1-S21's basis says the causes must be met.
THE_RE_ROUTE_ITSELF.what_it_does_NOT_close: the sibling does not add an arm, does not change check_lt_r1.py's output, and does not make x2-flag or x3-filed distinguish an empty window from a satisfied one. That is S18's, and S18 is UNEXECUTABLE-IN-PRINCIPLE. The document says so about itself.

THE_ADDITIVITY_BAR_IS_MEASURED_AGAINST_T.claim: measured -- 2.0.0_SA_COO~G at the cut, and it is why round 16's marker arm is NOT copied verbatim
THE_ADDITIVITY_BAR_IS_MEASURED_AGAINST_T.the_trap: LGIC_ENFORCE round 16 proved additivity by comparing check_en_r13.py's blob at its ROUND-13 PIN against HEAD, and they were identical because exactly ONE commit had ever touched that file.
THE_ADDITIVITY_BAR_IS_MEASURED_AGAINST_T.measured_here: check_lt_r1.py has SIX commits touching it (ef8197ed07, 56dbaee026, 60aac06844, 8db9eb1bd9, e1ffe52bdf, 39e6977e95, the last at 2026-09-17T23:28:01-04:00) -- legitimate repairs and amendments DURING round 1, before it closed.
THE_ADDITIVITY_BAR_IS_MEASURED_AGAINST_T.so: A BLOB-VS-ROUND-1-PIN COMPARISON WOULD FAIL ON HONEST HISTORY and would be a criterion no correct artifact could satisfy. The bar that actually answers the question is THE BLOB AT THIS CELL'S OWN base_sha AGAINST THE BLOB AT ITS HEAD: it proves THIS CELL did not touch the pinned input, which is the only thing this round can be responsible for.
THE_ADDITIVITY_BAR_IS_MEASURED_AGAINST_T.the_general_rule: AN ADDITIVITY PROOF IS ANCHORED TO THE ACTOR'S OWN BASE, NEVER TO A ROUND PIN -- a round pin conflates 'this cell did not edit it' with 'nobody ever edited it', and only the first is the cell's to guarantee.
